subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider after Google’s Vertex AI naming change?
rationale: Source confirms stale visible copy, but official Google wording differs from the issue’s exact requested phrase and provider-id changes would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update user-facing labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the visible label unchanged until maintainers decide that Google’s product/API/docs have settled enough to update OpenClaw copy.

options.title: Use a shorter Gemini Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt a compact UI label and document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider id and Vertex API/ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update user-facing labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.
